key: AYA: Fine, you win.
en: AYA: Fine, you win.
ja: アヤ: わかった、あんたの勝ちだよ。

key: ???: I know.
en: ???: I know.
ja: ???: だろうね。

key: FERN: Oh look, it's \PN, late to the party as usual.
en: FERN: Oh look, it's \PN, late to the party as usual.
ja: ファーン: おや、\PNじゃん、相変わらず遅刻魔だな。

key: Hey, don't worry!
en: Hey, don't worry!
ja: なあ、心配すんな!

key: This Gym Leader?
en: This Gym Leader?
ja: このジムリーダー?

key: Total noob.
en: Total noob.
ja: 完全に雑魚だぜ。

key: AYA: Excuse you? I beat you once before.
en: AYA: Excuse you? I beat you once before.
ja: アヤ: は? あんたに一回勝ったことあるけど。

key: FERN: Yeah, I was caught off guard by you fighting in Doubles.
en: FERN: Yeah, I was caught off guard by you fighting in Doubles.
ja: ファーン: ああ、お前がダブルで戦うのには、正直驚いたけどな。

key: Isn't that just a cheap way to cover for your lack of skill?
en: Isn't that just a cheap way to cover for your lack of skill?
ja: それって、実力不足をごまかす安っぽい手段ってだけじゃないのか?

key: AYA: I can fight in whatever format I want.
en: AYA: I can fight in whatever format I want.
ja: アヤ: あたしがどんな形式で戦おうと、あたしの勝手でしょ。

key: Besides, it was my brother who--
en: Besides, it was my brother who--
ja: それに、これはあたしの兄が――

key: LANA: AYA, YOU HAVE ANOTHER VISITOR!
en: LANA: AYA, YOU HAVE ANOTHER VISITOR!
ja: ラナ: アヤ、また お客さんよ!

key: AYA: REALLY, another one?
en: AYA: REALLY, another one?
ja: アヤ: マジで、また?

key: FERN: Can't blame people for wanting a free Badge.
en: FERN: Can't blame people for wanting a free Badge.
ja: ファーン: タダでバッジが欲しい奴らを責めるわけにもいかないしな。

key: AYA: Would you shut up please?
en: AYA: Would you shut up please?
ja: アヤ: ちょっと、黙っててくれる?

key: Just leave me alone.
en: Just leave me alone.
ja: あたしのことは放っといて。

key: HARDY: Did I come at a bad time?
en: HARDY: Did I come at a bad time?
ja: ハーディ: 悪いタイミングだったか?

key: FERN: Oh, it's you.
en: FERN: Oh, it's you.
ja: ファーン: なんだ、お前か。

key: HARDY: Yea, it's me. What're you doin' here?
en: HARDY: Yea, it's me. What're you doin' here?
ja: ハーディ: ああ、オレだよ。お前こそ、ここで何やってんだ?

key: FERN: Sweepin' scrubs. You?
en: FERN: Sweepin' scrubs. You?
ja: ファーン: 雑魚掃除だよ。お前は?

key: HARDY: Heard we got a new Gym Leader recently, so I'd been meaning to come down and welcome her to the club.
en: HARDY: Heard we got a new Gym Leader recently, so I'd been meaning to come down and welcome her to the club.
ja: ハーディ: 最近新しいジムリーダーが入ったって聞いてな、挨拶に来てやろうと思ってたんだぜ。

key: HARDY: You're Aya, yeah?
en: HARDY: You're Aya, yeah?
ja: ハーディ: お前がアヤだろ?

key: AYA: Um, yeah.
en: AYA: Um, yeah.
ja: アヤ: え、うん。

key: HARDY: Name's Hardy. Reborn's Rock Leader, at your service!
en: HARDY: Name's Hardy. Reborn's Rock Leader, at your service!
ja: ハーディ: 名前はハーディ。リボーンのいわタイプジムリーダー、よろしくな!

key: HARDY: Yanno, the plan was to give you a warm welcome, but...
en: HARDY: Yanno, the plan was to give you a warm welcome, but...
ja: ハーディ: 本当は温かく迎えるつもりだったんだけどな……

key: Looks like you kinda already got a sour one, huh, mate?
en: Looks like you kinda already got a sour one, huh, mate?
ja: なんか、もう嫌な思いさせられちゃってるみたいだな、相棒?

key: FERN: You can keep the snide comments to yourself, thanks.
en: FERN: You can keep the snide comments to yourself, thanks.
ja: ファーン: 皮肉なんて言わなくて結構だぜ。

key: AYA: So you two know each other?
en: AYA: So you two know each other?
ja: アヤ: あんたたち、知り合いなの?

key: HARDY: 'Fraid so.
en: HARDY: 'Fraid so.
ja: ハーディ: 残念ながらな。

key: I had the misfortune of being stuck in the same class as Fern in the Onyx Trainers' School.
en: I had the misfortune of being stuck in the same class as Fern in the Onyx Trainers' School.
ja: オニキストレーナーズスクールで、こいつと同じクラスになる不運に見舞われてな。

key: FERN: In short, Hardy's jealous because I was the top dog and he was just another loser.
en: FERN: In short, Hardy's jealous because I was the top dog and he was just another loser.
ja: ファーン: 要するに、オレがトップで、こいつがただの負け犬だったから、嫉妬してるんだよ。

key: HARDY: Keep tellin' yourself that, mate.
en: HARDY: Keep tellin' yourself that, mate.
ja: ハーディ: そう思ってりゃいいさ、相棒。

key: FERN: Plus our sisters used to be close friends, so we happened to get dragged to places together sometimes.
en: FERN: Plus our sisters used to be close friends, so we happened to get dragged to places together sometimes.
ja: ファーン: それに、お互いの姉貴同士が仲良かったから、たまに一緒に連れ回されてたんだよな。

key: HARDY: Aye. That's all in the past though.
en: HARDY: Aye. That's all in the past though.
ja: ハーディ: ああ。まあ、全部過去の話だけどな。

key: AYA: Yeah, okay, you guys keep chit-chatting.
en: AYA: Yeah, okay, you guys keep chit-chatting.
ja: アヤ: はいはい、あんたたちはおしゃべり続けてなよ。

key: I'm gonna go heal up my Pokémon with the machine in the other room.
en: I'm gonna go heal up my Pokémon with the machine in the other room.
ja: あたしは隣の部屋の機械で、ポケモン回復させてくるから。

key: FERN: So, \PN, you thinking of fighting Aya already?
en: FERN: So, \PN, you thinking of fighting Aya already?
ja: ファーン: それで、\PN、もうアヤと戦うつもりか?

key: Like I said, total pushover.
en: Like I said, total pushover.
ja: 言ったろ、完全な雑魚だって。

key: But it would be a shame if you came all the way down here and didn't have at least one good battle.
en: But it would be a shame if you came all the way down here and didn't have at least one good battle.
ja: でもまあ、わざわざここまで来て、いいバトルの一つもなかったら残念だよな。

key: Lemme help you out there, huh?
en: Lemme help you out there, huh?
ja: オレが力になってやるよ、な?

key: You know I let you win, right?
en: You know I let you win, right?
ja: オレ様が　勝たせてやったんだぞ? 分かってんのか

key: HARDY: I think seein' Fern get beat is worth the trip out here in itself.
en: HARDY: I think seein' Fern get beat is worth the trip out here in itself.
ja: ハーディ: ファーンがボコられるのを見るだけでも、ここまで来た価値はあるだろうな。

key: FERN: Stow it, Rocky.
en: FERN: Stow it, Rocky.
ja: ファーン: 黙れよ、石頭。

key: I was going easy on \PN.
en: I was going easy on \PN.
ja: \PNには手加減してやってただけだ。

key: After all, I wouldn't want to make anyone cry.
en: After all, I wouldn't want to make anyone cry.
ja: 誰かを泣かせたくはないからな。

key: HARDY: Whatever ya say, mate.
en: HARDY: Whatever ya say, mate.
ja: ハーディ: 好きに言ってろよ、相棒。

key: AYA: Okay. \PN, right?
en: AYA: Okay. \PN, right?
ja: アヤ: オーケー。\PNだっけ?

key: If you're ready for your battle, let's get started.
en: If you're ready for your battle, let's get started.
ja: バトルの準備ができてるなら、始めよっか。

key: FERN: Oh, I wanna see this.
en: FERN: Oh, I wanna see this.
ja: ファーン: おお、これは見物だな。

key: Popcorn all the way, baby.
en: Popcorn all the way, baby.
ja: ポップコーン用意しとかないとな。

key: HARDY: I'll referee the match.
en: HARDY: I'll referee the match.
ja: ハーディ: 審判はオレがやるぜ。

key: Someone's gotta keep Fern in check, an' I know the ropes from my own gym.
en: Someone's gotta keep Fern in check, an' I know the ropes from my own gym.
ja: 誰かがファーンを抑えとかないとな、それにオレも自分のジムでやり方は心得てる。

key: AYA: Ready when you are, I guess.
en: AYA: Ready when you are, I guess.
ja: アヤ: そっちの準備ができてるなら、いつでもいいよ。

key: AYA: Take your place so we get this over with.
en: AYA: Take your place so we get this over with.
ja: アヤ: 位置について。さっさと終わらせよう。

key: FERN: I'm not sure who I want to lose more.
en: FERN: I'm not sure who I want to lose more.
ja: ファーン: どっちに負けてほしいか、正直迷うな。

key: AYA: Do you just hate everyone by default, or what?
en: AYA: Do you just hate everyone by default, or what?
ja: アヤ: あんた、誰でもデフォルトで嫌いなわけ?

key: FERN: Nah, just you.
en: FERN: Nah, just you.
ja: ファーン: いや、お前だけだよ。

key: HARDY: Hey, lay off o' her, mate.
en: HARDY: Hey, lay off o' her, mate.
ja: ハーディ: おい、あいつには構うなよ、相棒。

key: AYA: No, no! It's fine, it's perfectly fine.
en: AYA: No, no! It's fine, it's perfectly fine.
ja: アヤ: ううん、いいの! 全然、平気だから。

key: He's right.
en: He's right.
ja: あいつの言う通りだし。

key: It's not like I'm good at this.
en: It's not like I'm good at this.
ja: あたし、これが得意ってわけでもないし。

key: I shouldn't even bother.
en: I shouldn't even bother.
ja: わざわざやることもないのかもね。

key: HARDY: Hey, now's not the time to doubt yourself.
en: HARDY: Hey, now's not the time to doubt yourself.
ja: ハーディ: おい、今は自分を疑ってる場合じゃないぜ。

key: Chin up.
en: Chin up.
ja: 顔上げてけ。

key: You're gonna rock this fight.
en: You're gonna rock this fight.
ja: このバトル、絶対うまくやれるさ。

key: AYA: I'd be better off if everyone just left me alone.
en: AYA: I'd be better off if everyone just left me alone.
ja: アヤ: みんな、あたしのことは放っといてくれた方がマシなのに。

key: HARDY: The challenger, \PN, faces the Leader, Aya, in a six-on-six Double Battle!
en: HARDY: The challenger, \PN, faces the Leader, Aya, in a six-on-six Double Battle!
ja: ハーディ: 挑戦者\PN、リーダー・アヤとの6対6ダブルバトル、開始だ!

key: AYA: I don't even really want to do this.
en: AYA: I don't even really want to do this.
ja: アヤ: そもそも、こんなことやりたくもないんだから。

key: I just got saddled with it.
en: I just got saddled with it.
ja: ただ押し付けられただけ。

key: HARDY: Either competitor can make substitutions.
en: HARDY: Either competitor can make substitutions.
ja: ハーディ: どちらの選手も、ポケモンの交代は自由だ。

key: The battle's over when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon can no longer fight!
en: The battle's over when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon can no longer fight!
ja: どちらかのトレーナーの6匹が全て戦えなくなった時点で、バトル終了!

key: AYA: We're doing this again...
en: AYA: We're doing this again...
ja: アヤ: また、これやるの……

key: Why can't you just leave me alone?
en: Why can't you just leave me alone?
ja: どうして放っといてくれないの?

key: HARDY: You both did great last time.
en: HARDY: You both did great last time.
ja: ハーディ: 前回は、二人ともよくやってたぜ。

key: Let's give it all ya got this time too, aye?
en: Let's give it all ya got this time too, aye?
ja: 今回も全力でいこうぜ、な?

key: The challenger, \PN, will rematch the Leader, Aya, in a six-on-six Double Battle!
en: The challenger, \PN, will rematch the Leader, Aya, in a six-on-six Double Battle!
ja: 挑戦者\PN、リーダー・アヤとの再戦、6対6ダブルバトル!

key: Either competitor can make substitutions.
en: Either competitor can make substitutions.
ja: どちらの選手も、ポケモンの交代は自由だ。

key: The battle is over when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon can no longer fight!
en: The battle is over when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon can no longer fight!
ja: どちらかのトレーナーの6匹が全て戦えなくなった時点で、バトル終了!

key: And roll!
en: And roll!
ja: それじゃ、始め!

key: At least I won't have to deal with this again.
en: At least I won't have to deal with this again.
ja: まあ　もう二度と　こんなことしなくて済むし

key: AYA: So I lost.
en: AYA: So I lost.
ja: アヤ: で、負けたと。

key: At least that means I don't have to deal with you again, I guess.
en: At least that means I don't have to deal with you again, I guess.
ja: まあ、これでもうあんたの相手をしなくて済むってことか。

key: FERN: Cold.
en: FERN: Cold.
ja: ファーン: 冷たいな。

key: I think I woulda preferred it if \PN had bombed after all.
en: I think I woulda preferred it if \PN had bombed after all.
ja: \PNがボロ負けしてくれた方が、まだよかったかもな。

key: Whatever. Later, losers!
en: Whatever. Later, losers!
ja: どうでもいいけど。じゃあな、負け犬ども!

key: HARDY: Heyo, Aya, don't take a couple losses too hard, aye?
en: HARDY: Heyo, Aya, don't take a couple losses too hard, aye?
ja: ハーディ: おい、アヤ、たかが数回負けたくらいで、そんなに落ち込むなよ、な?

key: It happens, and you put up a solid fight.
en: It happens, and you put up a solid fight.
ja: よくあることだし、お前はしっかり戦ってたぜ。

key: You just psyched yourself out beforehand.
en: You just psyched yourself out beforehand.
ja: ただ、戦う前から自分で自分を追い込んでただけだろ。

key: AYA: I don't care.
en: AYA: I don't care.
ja: アヤ: どうでもいい。

key: HARDY: C'mon, no need to be so cold about it.
en: HARDY: C'mon, no need to be so cold about it.
ja: ハーディ: おいおい、そんな突き放さなくてもいいだろ。

key: AYA: What, you sensitive to rejection too?
en: AYA: What, you sensitive to rejection too?
ja: アヤ: 何、あんたも拒絶されるの気にするタイプ?

key: HARDY: Nah, I mean you're being cold to yourself.
en: HARDY: Nah, I mean you're being cold to yourself.
ja: ハーディ: いや、お前が自分自身に冷たいって話だよ。

key: You deserve better than that, aye?
en: You deserve better than that, aye?
ja: お前はもっと大事にされていいはずだろ、な?

key: AYA: ...Whatever.
en: AYA: ...Whatever.
ja: アヤ: ……別に、どうでもいい。

key: I never wanted this anyway.
en: I never wanted this anyway.
ja: そもそも、こんなの望んでなかったし。

key: It was never supposed to be my job.
en: It was never supposed to be my job.
ja: あたしの仕事になるはずじゃなかったのに。

key: But my stupid baby brother dumped this onto me.
en: But my stupid baby brother dumped this onto me.
ja: でも、あのバカな弟が、あたしに押し付けたの。

key: Emphasis on the baby.
en: Emphasis on the baby.
ja: 「バカ」の部分、強調しとくね。

key: AYA: He probably hates us.
en: AYA: He probably hates us.
ja: アヤ: あいつ、たぶんあたしたちのこと嫌いなんだと思う。

key: HARDY: Why would he hate you?
en: HARDY: Why would he hate you?
ja: ハーディ: なんでお前を嫌うんだよ?

key: AYA: Ask him. I'm just not a good person, I guess.
en: AYA: Ask him. I'm just not a good person, I guess.
ja: アヤ: あいつに聞いてよ。あたしがいい人間じゃないってだけかもね。

key: But he hasn't talked to any of us since he ran away.
en: But he hasn't talked to any of us since he ran away.
ja: でも、家出してから、誰とも話してないの。

key: One day he just up and left.
en: One day he just up and left.
ja: ある日、いきなり出て行っちゃって。

key: Didn't say good bye.
en: Didn't say good bye.
ja: さよならも言わずに。

key: Didn't even take his Pokémon with him.
en: Didn't even take his Pokémon with him.
ja: 自分のポケモンすら、連れて行かなかった。

key: He was the one who went out and earned the Gym Leader title.
en: He was the one who went out and earned the Gym Leader title.
ja: ジムリーダーの称号を勝ち取ったのは、あいつだったのに。

key: And then he decided he was over it.
en: And then he decided he was over it.
ja: それなのに、突然もういいって決めたの。

key: So now I'm stuck doing it.
en: So now I'm stuck doing it.
ja: だから今、あたしがやらされてる。

key: Mom won't even talk about him anymore.
en: Mom won't even talk about him anymore.
ja: お母さんはもう、あいつの話すらしない。

key: And I'm not cut out for this.
en: And I'm not cut out for this.
ja: あたしには、こんなの向いてないのに。

key: HARDY: Hey, calm down already, a'ite? You're fine.
en: HARDY: Hey, calm down already, a'ite? You're fine.
ja: ハーディ: おい、もう落ち着けって、な? お前は大丈夫だ。

key: Tell ya what-- why don't I stick around for a bit and help you guys out with some stuff?
en: Tell ya what-- why don't I stick around for a bit and help you guys out with some stuff?
ja: こうしないか――しばらくここに残って、色々手伝ってやるよ。

key: AYA: Why? Just leave me alone.
en: AYA: Why? Just leave me alone.
ja: アヤ: なんで? 放っといてってば。

key: HARDY: Nah, I don't think that'd be a good move right about now.
en: HARDY: Nah, I don't think that'd be a good move right about now.
ja: ハーディ: いや、今それはあんまりいい手じゃないと思うぜ。

key: Why don't you start by giving \PN their righteously- earned badge?
en: Why don't you start by giving \PN their righteously- earned badge?
ja: まずは\PNに、正当に勝ち取ったバッジを渡すところから始めたらどうだ?

key: Then you and I'll get stuff worked out, aye?
en: Then you and I'll get stuff worked out, aye?
ja: それからお前とオレとで、色々話し合おうぜ、な?

key: AYA: Sure.
en: AYA: Sure.
ja: アヤ: わかった。

key: AYA: This is the Blight Badge. Take it.
en: AYA: This is the Blight Badge. Take it.
ja: アヤ: これがブライトバッジ。受け取って。

key: \PN received the Blight Badge!
en: \PN received the Blight Badge!
ja: \PNはブライトバッジを受け取った!

key: AYA: Pokémon up to level 50 will listen to you now.
en: AYA: Pokémon up to level 50 will listen to you now.
ja: アヤ: これで、レベル50までのポケモンが言うことを聞くようになる。

key: And you can use the Machine Strength outside of battle.
en: And you can use the Machine Strength outside of battle.
ja: それに、バトルの外でマシンのかいりきが使えるようになる。

key: ...And I guess I'm supposed to give you this.
en: ...And I guess I'm supposed to give you this.
ja: ……それと、これも渡すことになってるんだった。

key: AYA: Sludge Wave hits every target, and has a chance to poison each of them.
en: AYA: Sludge Wave hits every target, and has a chance to poison each of them.
ja: アヤ: ヘドロウェーブは全員に当たって、それぞれに毒を与える可能性がある。

key: Go figure, all I'm good for is spreading something toxic like that.
en: Go figure, all I'm good for is spreading something toxic like that.
ja: まあ、あたしが得意なのはそういう毒をまき散らすことだけ、ってわけ。

key: AYA: You can go now.
en: AYA: You can go now.
ja: アヤ: もう行っていいよ。

key: HARDY: \PN, I look forward to seein' you in my Gym up in Agate City someday.
en: HARDY: \PN, I look forward to seein' you in my Gym up in Agate City someday.
ja: ハーディ: \PN、いつかアゲートシティのオレのジムで会えるのを楽しみにしてるぜ。

key: Don't let me down, aye?
en: Don't let me down, aye?
ja: がっかりさせるなよ、な?

key: Peace!
en: Peace!
ja: じゃあな!

key: AYA: There's no point in trying to hash this out with you.
en: AYA: There's no point in trying to hash this out with you.
ja: アヤ: あんたとこの話、突き詰めても意味ないから。

key: You'll just get bored and either hate me or leave me.
en: You'll just get bored and either hate me or leave me.
ja: どうせ飽きて、あたしのこと嫌いになるか、いなくなるかするんでしょ。

key: Just like everyone else.
en: Just like everyone else.
ja: みんなと同じように。

key: HARDY: ...You wanna bet?
en: HARDY: ...You wanna bet?
ja: ハーディ: ……賭けるか?

key: AYA: What?
en: AYA: What?
ja: アヤ: は?

key: HARDY: Let's bet on it.
en: HARDY: Let's bet on it.
ja: ハーディ: それ、賭けようぜ。

key: AYA: Like money?
en: AYA: Like money?
ja: アヤ: お金を?

key: HARDY: Yeah, like money.
en: HARDY: Yeah, like money.
ja: ハーディ: ああ、金を賭けてな。

key: If you're so sure of that, you shouldn't need to hesitate, right?
en: If you're so sure of that, you shouldn't need to hesitate, right?
ja: そんなに確信があるなら、ためらう必要なんてないだろ?

key: As long as there's some doubt, you may as well either try.
en: As long as there's some doubt, you may as well either try.
ja: もし少しでも疑いがあるなら、どうせなら試してみたらいいさ。

key: Or make a penny off of it instead, yanno?

ja: それか、代わりに小銭でも稼いどけよ、な?

key: AYA: ...Hmph.

ja: アヤ: ……フン。

key: HARDY: Good luck, mate.
en: HARDY: Good luck, mate.
ja: ハーディ: 幸運を祈るぜ、相棒。

key: FERN: Good luck, I guess.

ja: ファーン: 幸運を祈っとくよ、一応。

key: That seems to be the only way you win.

ja: それくらいしか、お前が勝つ方法はなさそうだしな。

key: HARDY: I don't think anyone likes seein' anyone sad.

ja: ハーディ: 誰だって、誰かが悲しんでるのを見たいわけじゃないだろ。

ja: だから、話してみろよ、相棒。

key: But that wasn't what this was.

ja: でも、そういうつもりじゃなかったんだ。

key: This was a courtesy call, and then I saw someone who really looks like they could use some help.
en: This was a courtesy call, and then I saw someone who really looks like they could use some help.
ja: ただの挨拶のつもりが、本当に助けを必要としてそうな奴を見かけただけでな。

key: Will you just take it?
en: Will you just take it?
ja: 素直に受け取ってくれないか?
